Storage is managed automatically: old programmes are removed every day, logos are capped, and the database is compacted when needed.

Add the TV service you subscribe to (an Xtream Codes login or an M3U playlist address), or start with free TV: channels streamed free by their broadcasters, and public-domain films and series. You can add the other at any time in Settings › Playlists.
Free TV, films and series

Saves your playlists (with their logins), channel and category choices, favourites, TV guide sources and settings to a file. Copy it with a file manager app to keep it somewhere else. The file isn\'t encrypted, so keep it private.
Only the categories you tick are downloaded, so lists load faster and use less storage.
Its channels, TV guide, films and series are up to date.
+ Add free TV, films and series
Continue watching in the home screen\'s Play Next row, and your favourite channels, movies and series as rows of their own. Restricted titles and channels never go there.

Off. Add your own free TMDB key to show the cast, trailers and links on film and series pages.
On. Film and series pages show more from TMDB.

With your own TMDB key, film and series pages show the cast and crew, trailers, links to IMDb and TMDB, and missing episode descriptions. To get a free key, sign in at themoviedb.org, then go to Settings › API. MyTVPlayer sends the names of the films and series that you open to TMDB.
Cast, crew, trailers and links for films and series. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
